messages:
Diego: FYI - seeing a cluster of orgs showing $0 / NaN on the Token Cost dashboard. Started ~22:40 PST after the funnel-agg rollout.
Ashley: Which orgs? any common pattern? customer-facing?
Diego: small sample: org_8392, org_1221, org_551. All in EU region, mix of hosted + reserved. Maya from support flagged 3 escalations.
Maya: Confirmed. Support tickets INC-3982, INC-3983, INC-3984. Customers report blank tiles and CSV export shows "NaN" and "0.00" in cost column.
Jonathan: I'm looking at the ledger join logs. Seeing a join key mismatch between usage_rollups and price_catalog for a subset of legacy orgs. Diving in now.
Ashley: Can someone add repro steps?
Maya: Quick repro I did:
```
1) Console -> Billing -> Token Cost
2) Filter org = org_8392, timeframe = last 7d
3) Tile shows $0, CSV contains NaN in cost column
```
Diego: Screenshot attached to INC-3982. Also noticed rollup job warning: `WARN: price_lookup returned null for model_id=redwood-base-1` in funnel-agg logs.
Jonathan: That explains it — price_catalog migration/backfill missed aliases prefixed with `legacy-`. The left join returns null and downstream coalesce yields 0/NaN in viz.
Maya: Customers need ETA. Can we hotfix the backfill or change UI behavior to avoid showing $0?
Diego: Short-term: change dashboard to surface "missing price" and link to support ticket. Medium-term: backfill price_catalog for legacy aliases and fix alias mapping.
Ashley: I'll create an ops runbook and coordinate. Assigning ENG-RELEASES for backfill rollout and ENG-ML for model alias mapping check.
sre-bot: Deploy pipeline for funnel-agg rollback queued: job id deploy-20240309-0223. Manual approval required to rollback.
billing-bot: Created billing-ticket BT-1129 linking INC-3982/INC-3983/INC-3984. Tags: priority=high, impact=partial-visibility.
Jonathan: Quick SQL I ran to find missing prices:
```
select u.org_id, u.model_id, p.price
from usage_rollups u
left join price_catalog p on p.model_canonical = u.model_id
where p.price is null
limit 10;
```
Diego: Does this affect hosted API customers or only legacy reserved orgs?
Maya: Both hosted and reserved in EU so far. No reports from dedicated infra yet.
Ashley: Action list: (1) ENG-ML add alias backfill PR, (2) temporary UI change to avoid NaN and show "missing price", (3) ops runbook + customer comms. I'll update INC-3982 with timeline.
Jonathan: Starting backfill script now, ETA ~30m. Will post logs here.
Jonathan: BACKFILL LOGS: added 428 rows to price_catalog, 0 errors. Patch deployed to staging. Monitoring cost-tile metrics.
Diego: Rechecked dashboard for org_8392 — now shows $12.40. Marking incidents as triaged. :thumbsup: 
Maya: Closing initial escalations; will keep customers updated with notes and next-steps.
Ashley: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem doc after stabilization.
